source.citation: Kunkel ME, Herkommer A, Reinehr M, Böckers TM, Wilke HJ. Morphometric analysis of the relationships between intervertebral disc and vertebral body heights: an anatomical and radiographic study of the human thoracic spine. J Anat. 2011;219:375-387.
source.measurement_method: lateral radiographic vertebral body corner heights; not direct anatomical vertebral body caliper
source.population_caveat: Mixed sex, roughly middle-aged-to-elderly cadavers, detached spine segments in neutral radiographic position; not 1.82-m live male standing spine.

interpretation.positive_posterior_minus_anterior_mm: posterior radiographic vertebral-body height exceeds anterior: qualitative kyphotic body wedging, not an angular magnitude
interpretation.c7_role: cross-source cervicothoracic reference only; current C7 male-height selection remains separate
interpretation.reference_target: canonical_spine_level_stack_v1.json contains previously stored T1-T12 arithmetic averages; do not overwrite them
unavailable_from_table: vertebral anterior-posterior sagittal depth needed to calculate geometric wedge angles
standing segmental superior-endplate orientation and sagittal reference frame
direct 3D vertebral bone surfaces and facet/rib contact geometry
valid in-vivo neutral loaded posture and person-specific variation
interpretation.allowed_output: read-only T1-T12 level-by-level anterior/posterior height contrast and cross-source consistency diagnostic
